response.justification: Bogdan is a versatile, experienced full-stack and systems engineer with nearly two decades of hands-on development across web, embedded, and infrastructure domains, but his profile does not match the Director-level, AI-strategy-focused Principal Engineer role. He lacks demonstrated deep AI/ML expertise, advanced AI education, strategic customer advisory experience, or a track record of building recognized AI products/platforms — the core requirements for this position.
strengths: 15+ years of diverse software engineering experience across multiple stacks and domains
Recent exposure to AI-agent infrastructure and MCP tooling at re:cinq
Demonstrated ability to teach, mentor, and lead technical workshops
concerns: No advanced degree or specialized background in AI/ML as preferred for this role
Career trajectory shows Senior/Staff-level titles, not Principal/Director-level strategic leadership
No evidence of advising strategic customers or partners on cloud/AI adoption at an executive level

key_factors.factor: Lack of AI specialization and thought leadership
